response: Visceral adipose tissue (VAT) area measurement at a single level, specifically 3 cm above the lower margin of the L3 vertebra, can indeed represent visceral adipose tissue volume. This measurement is feasible and can reflect changes in VAT volume and body weight. In fact, advances in knowledge suggest that VAT area at this specific location can best reflect interval changes in VAT volume and body weight, making it a suitable choice for measurement. Therefore, measuring VAT area at this single level can be a reliable indicator of visceral adipose tissue volume.
